defects.title: Cross-device changes are not visible until restart
defects.manualValidation: Edit the same task from iPhone, iPad, and web and verify both already-open peers update without restart.
defects.limitations: Automated tests use mocked realtime and repository boundaries; they do not prove a live three-device Supabase session.

defects.title: Deleted records return after sync or restart
defects.manualValidation: Delete test records, restart each client, sync in different orders, and confirm no record reappears.
defects.limitations: Automated evidence validates merge and tombstone rules but cannot reproduce every historical cloud row.

defects.title: Task totals, completion, and attention states disagree
defects.manualValidation: Compare project and portfolio totals plus attention/report states across all clients after reopening and completing tasks.
defects.limitations: Fixtures cover known authority rules, not every combination of legacy schedule imports and live field evidence.

defects.title: Schedule documents duplicate, lose current status, or fail extraction
defects.manualValidation: Upload one multi-project schedule, verify extraction, current-version selection, and identical document history everywhere.
defects.limitations: Local tests cannot certify the live storage bucket, extraction provider, or every PDF layout.

defects.title: Storage or hydration failure corrupts the visible project state
defects.manualValidation: Exercise launch, background/foreground, network loss, retry, and restart against a representative cloud account.
defects.limitations: Failure injection validates containment paths but not device storage pressure or operating-system termination behavior.

defects.title: Navigation and touch response becomes unacceptably slow
defects.manualValidation: Measure cold launch and repeated page-to-page touch response on supported physical devices with realistic data.
defects.limitations: Unit timing checks detect algorithmic regression but do not measure rendered frames, touch latency, or device memory pressure.

defects.title: Reports or alerts misrepresent current project truth
defects.manualValidation: Review generated reports against the current task list, completed areas, schedule version, and latest PM-authorized changes.
defects.limitations: Deterministic fixtures enforce known rules but PM review remains necessary for the accuracy and usefulness of real project narratives.

defects.title: Photo intelligence cannot compare valid progress photos
defects.manualValidation: Run known same-area/different-angle photo pairs and verify provider errors, comparisons, and PM-facing conclusions.
defects.limitations: Mocked responses cannot certify current external AI behavior, edge-function deployment, network availability, or a specific jobsite image pair.

defects.title: Task dates and edited notes do not preserve user input
defects.manualValidation: Create and edit task dates and multi-word notes with the native keyboard on iPhone and iPad, then confirm the saved cloud value on web.
defects.limitations: Component tests verify control wiring; they cannot reproduce every third-party keyboard or operating-system text-input behavior.

defects.title: Queued task, area, or document changes never retry after connectivity returns
defects.manualValidation: Edit a task, area, and document offline, restore connectivity without making another edit, and confirm the queue clears and the already-open peer device updates.
defects.limitations: Deterministic retry tests validate triggers, backoff, and result inspection but do not certify operating-system connectivity events or the live cloud.

defects.title: Evidence from a deleted task changes active totals or reports
defects.manualValidation: Delete a task that has field evidence, then confirm the evidence remains labeled in history but is excluded from active totals, attention, and reports on all clients.
defects.limitations: Fixtures prove the shared selector and native/web wiring; the historical cloud rows on the test account still require live reconciliation.

defects.title: Web displays Connected while its project data is stale
defects.manualValidation: Interrupt the web connection after a successful load and verify Connected changes to Reconnecting and then Stale with the last successful refresh time.
defects.limitations: Component and state tests do not reproduce every browser, proxy, captive portal, or background-throttling condition.

defects.title: Important schedule and intelligence actions are hard to tap or identify
defects.manualValidation: Use VoiceOver and one-handed touch on iPhone and iPad to verify schedule Open, Set Active, Delete, Confirm, and Dismiss controls.
defects.limitations: Static contracts enforce minimum dimensions and names but cannot measure physical reachability, Dynamic Type clipping, or spoken order.

defects.title: A cloud document record exists but its verified file cannot be opened
defects.manualValidation: Remove one app-owned local schedule and project document, keep the trusted cloud record, reopen each file, and confirm exact byte recovery or a clear re-add-original message for legacy records.
defects.limitations: Core tests prove size/hash verification and fail-closed cleanup, while live storage permissions, large files, and device disk pressure still require device testing.

defects.title: A temporary web refresh failure replaces the last verified workspace
defects.manualValidation: Load the web workspace, interrupt its cloud connection, select Refresh, and confirm the last verified project data remains visible with an honest reconnecting or stale status.
defects.limitations: Provider tests verify state continuity and freshness presentation but cannot reproduce every browser background policy, proxy, or live Supabase outage.

defects.title: Live refresh erases an in-progress task form
defects.manualValidation: Begin entering a new task on one device, change project data from another client, and confirm the open form keeps every unsaved field until the user saves or cancels.
defects.limitations: Component tests replay prop refreshes but do not certify every realtime event sequence or operating-system keyboard behavior.

defects.title: Areas from one project appear in another project's workflows
defects.manualValidation: Create same-named and different-named areas in both active projects, then verify task, update, document, walk, and Talk selectors show only the selected project's areas.
defects.limitations: Local inference tests fail closed for ambiguous legacy areas; durable database ownership and live RLS enforcement still require the approved cloud migration.

defects.title: A saved report appears current after its source facts changed
defects.manualValidation: Approve a report, change a scoped task, field update, photo analysis, GPS fact, or current schedule, and confirm the report requires refresh without invalidating itself merely because the report record was saved.
defects.limitations: Fixtures verify source selection and provenance fields; a PM must still compare the generated narrative with the live project before communication.

defects.title: Web shows project evidence metadata but cannot open the protected source
defects.manualValidation: Open current and legacy mobile-uploaded photos and documents from the web app, confirm short-lived access works for the signed-in owner, and verify another owner's or an invented path is rejected.
defects.limitations: Gateway tests prove owner checks, path allowlisting, and signed-URL handling with mocks; live storage RLS, object existence, and browser download behavior require connected testing.

defects.title: A shared area name assigns field updates and photos to the wrong parent project
defects.manualValidation: Create the same area name in both projects, save a task-linked update in each, and confirm Overview, Projects, Field Activity, Photos, Talk, documents, and reports show each update only under its authoritative parent project.
defects.limitations: Deterministic scope tests prove task-id and explicit-parent precedence and fail closed for ambiguous legacy labels; existing ambiguous cloud rows still require a signed-in reconciliation review.

defects.title: Deleting a project leaves parent-linked updates or owned areas able to return
defects.manualValidation: Delete a disposable project containing task-linked field updates, areas, schedule items, and documents, restart both mobile apps, refresh web, and confirm none of those active records return.
defects.limitations: The atomic local transaction and resurrection barriers are tested; final cloud purge and regulated retention behavior remain subject to the approved server-side policy and live RLS validation.

defects.title: A stale offline queue recreates deleted work or loses deletion confirmation

namedTests.name: drops a stale queued task that matches a durable local tombstone without deleting the tombstone

defects.manualValidation: Delete a task, area, document, and field update while another device has stale queued edits; reconnect in both orders and confirm no deleted record returns and each queue clears without repeating the field-update delete.
defects.limitations: Deterministic storage and gateway tests prove local/cloud tombstone precedence and two-phase confirmation; live multi-device timing, operating-system termination, and Supabase availability still require connected device testing.

defects.title: Signing out or switching accounts exposes another owner's local project data
defects.manualValidation: Sign in as one test owner, save local-only changes, sign out, sign in as a different owner, and confirm each account sees only its own local workspace after restarts and interrupted account changes.
defects.limitations: The storage sandbox tests prove key classification, owner switching, interrupted-transition recovery, and fail-closed corruption behavior; device keychain behavior and real authentication events still require physical-device validation.

defects.title: A backup omits media, exposes plaintext, or restores modified data
defects.manualValidation: Create a complete backup containing task data, photos, schedules, and project documents; restore it on a clean test device with the correct passphrase, then verify wrong-passphrase and modified-file restores fail without partial data.
defects.limitations: Cryptographic tests prove authenticated encryption, manifest integrity, wrong-passphrase rejection, and exact byte recovery; device disk pressure, share-sheet destinations, and very large real archives still require physical-device testing.

defects.title: Deleting a record leaves its protected cloud file behind indefinitely

namedTests.name: keeps a failed removal retryable and records only generic user-safe detail

defects.manualValidation: Delete disposable photos, documents, updates, and projects from each client, confirm their protected files disappear, and verify a forced storage failure stays retryable until the next successful sync.
defects.limitations: Runtime tests prove retry and receipt behavior, while live storage RLS, service availability, and deletion timing still require the approved migration and connected validation.
